cause.mtu_pending: The path MTU is still being measured.
cause.management_clock: The secure connection to the VPS failed. Check the clocks on this device and the VPS.
cause.management_credentials_invalid: The saved server identity or this device’s certificate is invalid.
cause.management_device_rejected: The VPS rejected this device’s certificate.
cause.management_access_rejected: The VPS rejected this device’s current access.
cause.management_unreachable: The VPS management service couldn’t be reached through the VPN.

message.local_identity_unavailable: The device identity could not be opened. Unlock the system secret store or this phone, then retry. Restore a device backup or enroll again if the identity is missing.
message.local_identity_loaded: The saved server pin and device certificate/key can be loaded. Their current server authorization is checked over the VPN.
message.management_disconnected: Connect this device to the selected server to check authenticated management, current server DNS, VPS networking and traffic leaks. Local checks are available while disconnected.
message.management_accepted: The private management service accepted the pinned TLS connection and this device’s current authorization.
message.local_backend_unavailable: The local VPN service did not return a usable state. Open the app’s connection screen and refresh; repair or reinstall the local component if it remains unavailable.
message.local_tunnel_another_server: Another server owns the local VPN. Select that server to inspect its current tunnel, or disconnect it before connecting this server.
message.local_tunnel_unmatched: The active tunnel could not be matched to the selected server. Refresh connection state before running remote checks.
message.local_tunnel_paused: Reconnection is paused for your decision. Use Resume in the connection screen when ready.
message.local_tunnel_recovering: The local service is recovering the connection. Wait for a fresh handshake; if recovery does not finish, review transport and endpoint settings.
message.local_tunnel_connected: The local VPN service reports an active tunnel for the selected server.
message.local_tunnel_connecting: A connection attempt is running. Wait for it to finish or cancel it from the connection screen.
message.local_tunnel_degraded: The selected tunnel has no current usable connection. Check the network and endpoint; automatic transport selection can try another configured carrier.
message.local_tunnel_disconnected: This device is disconnected. Connect to run current tunnel and server checks.
message.local_backend_responded: The native VPN service responded to the current status request.
message.protection_armed: The native service reports the kill switch armed for the active connection.
message.protection_blocking: The kill switch is blocking unprotected traffic. Connectivity may remain blocked until the VPN recovers or protection is explicitly disabled.
message.protection_off: The kill switch is off. Enable it in connection settings if traffic must remain blocked outside the VPN.
message.protection_failed: Traffic protection could not be enforced. Recheck the native service or Android Always-on and Block connections without VPN settings before relying on protection.
message.protection_unknown: The current kill switch state is unavailable. Refresh native status or check Android VPN protection settings.
message.transport_direct_udp: Direct UDP is selected for the current tunnel. If it cannot establish a handshake, check the public UDP port or choose Automatic transport.
message.transport_obfuscated_udp: Obfuscated UDP is selected for the current tunnel. If it cannot connect, check its public UDP port and current server keys.
message.transport_tcp_fallback: TCP fallback is selected for the current tunnel. If it cannot connect, check its public TCP port and current server keys.
message.transport_tls_like: Pinned TLS/HTTPS transport is selected for the current tunnel. If it cannot connect, check its public TCP port, endpoint pin and configured HTTPS name/path.
message.transport_quic: QUIC (HTTP/3) is selected for the current tunnel. If it cannot connect, check that the VPS accepts UDP on its TCP/TLS port number; some networks block QUIC entirely.
message.routing_applications: Application routing is selected. Only the configured applications use this VPN; the private management and DNS routes remain included.
message.routing_subnets: Selected-subnet routing is configured. Only those subnets and the private management and DNS routes use this VPN.
message.routing_full: Full-tunnel routing is configured. Explicit local-network or application exceptions still follow the saved policy.
message.ipv6_tunneled: IPv6 is configured inside the VPN for included traffic.
message.ipv6_blocked: IPv6 outside the supported VPN route is blocked by the current policy.
message.ipv6_unhandled: This configuration does not claim to tunnel or block all IPv6. Review routing exceptions and system lockdown settings.
message.quality_sample: {{received}} of {{sent}} probes returned; average latency {{latency}} ms, jitter {{jitter}} ms. This is a current private-tunnel sample, not an Internet speed test.
message.quality_unavailable: No fresh private-tunnel quality sample is available. ICMP filtering can prevent measurement even when the VPN works.
message.mtu_unavailable: No current path MTU reading is available. Check Network settings after the tunnel connects.
message.mtu_pending: Path probing is pending. Keep the connection active until a current measurement is available.
message.mtu_icmp_unavailable: ICMP probing is unavailable. This does not establish an MTU failure; use a manual value only when the network’s MTU is known.
message.mtu_no_usable: Small probes returned but no supported nonfragmenting size worked. Try another transport; IPv6 requires at least 1280 bytes.
message.mtu_apply_failed: The measured MTU could not be applied. Reconnect or review the manual MTU in Network settings.
message.mtu_smaller: The path supports a smaller MTU. Review the suggestion in Network settings; automatic application waits for protection and idle conditions.
message.mtu_verified: The configured size was verified by the current path probes.
message.mtu_incomplete: The reported MTU measurement is incomplete. Refresh connection state to obtain a usable suggestion.
message.management_invalid_server_identity: The saved server certificate pin is invalid. Restore a trusted device backup or use the authenticated endpoint recovery flow; do not accept an unverified replacement certificate.
message.management_invalid_client_identity: The saved device management certificate/key is invalid. Restore a device backup or enroll this device again.
message.management_tls_failed: The private TLS handshake failed. Check the pinned server identity, this device’s enrollment and both device and VPS clocks. Do not bypass certificate verification.
message.management_timed_out: The private management request timed out. Check the local tunnel, included management route and VPS service. A timeout alone does not identify a certificate problem.
message.management_incompatible: The VPS management protocol is incompatible. Update the app and VPS to compatible versions.
message.management_authentication_rejected: The VPS rejected device authentication. Check the enrolled device certificate and recover or enroll again if it was replaced.
message.management_access_rejected: The VPS rejected this device’s current access. The owner can check device revocation, member suspension, expiration and access schedules.
message.management_rate_limited: The VPS is limiting requests. Wait briefly, then rerun diagnostics.
message.management_rejected: The authenticated VPS rejected diagnostics. Check current device access and compatible app/server versions.
message.management_connection_failed: The private management connection did not complete. Check tunnel connectivity, its private route, the VPS service and pinned identities. The current response cannot distinguish those causes.
message.local_dns_available: The private VPS resolver returned a matching DNS response through the current VPN.
message.local_dns_servfail: The private resolver returned SERVFAIL. Check VPS upstream DNS, DNSSEC validation and the VPS clock.
message.local_dns_refused: The private resolver refused the query. Check resolver access policy and server DNS configuration.
message.local_dns_timeout: The private resolver did not reply within three seconds. Check the tunnel’s DNS route, port 53 rules and VPS resolver service.
message.local_dns_connect_failed: The private resolver’s TCP port 53 could not be reached through the VPN. Check the included DNS route and VPS resolver service.
message.local_dns_invalid_reply: The private resolver returned an invalid or mismatched DNS reply. Check VPS DNS configuration and rerun diagnostics.
message.local_dns_unavailable: The current VPN network or source address was unavailable for a private DNS probe. Connect or wait for recovery, then retry.
message.leak_unsupported: Your VPS can’t run the leak test yet. Update or repair the VPS, then run diagnostics again.
message.leak_applications_only: Only the selected applications use this VPN, so this check doesn’t apply to this device’s own traffic.
message.leak_subnets_only: Only the selected subnets use this VPN, so other {{family}} traffic uses your normal network by design.
message.leak_tunneled: A request to an internet {{family}} address went through the VPN: your VPS received it from this device’s VPN address.
message.leak_other_source: Your VPS received the {{family}} test request from an address other than this device’s VPN address. Reconnect, then run diagnostics again.
message.leak_outside: This device sends internet {{family}} traffic outside the VPN, so websites can see your normal address unless the kill switch blocks it. Reconnect with full-tunnel routing and the kill switch on, then run diagnostics again.
message.leak_unconfirmed: The {{family}} test request didn’t reach your VPS through the VPN, so this device’s internet {{family}} traffic isn’t confirmed to use it. Reconnect and run diagnostics again; if it keeps failing, repair the VPS.
message.leak_ipv6_no_route: This VPN doesn’t carry IPv6, and this device has no IPv6 internet route, so no IPv6 traffic can leave outside the VPN.
message.leak_ipv6_blocked: This VPN doesn’t carry IPv6. The kill switch reports IPv6 blocked, but your VPS has no IPv6 tunnel to confirm it.
message.leak_ipv6_outside: This device can send IPv6 outside the VPN, which doesn’t carry IPv6, so IPv6 websites can see your normal address. Turn on the kill switch to block IPv6.
message.leak_dns_pass: A one-off name looked up through this device’s normal DNS was answered by your VPS resolver.
message.leak_dns_fail: A one-off name looked up through this device’s normal DNS wasn’t answered by your VPS resolver, so DNS queries go to another resolver, possibly outside the VPN. Check for a manually set DNS server or a local DNS service, then reconnect.
message.report_format: Some server checks could not be safely interpreted. Use compatible app and server versions and rerun diagnostics.
message.dns_valid: The resolver returned a valid DNS response.
message.dns_unavailable: A current DNS response check is unavailable. Try again after other diagnostics finish.
message.dns_failed: The resolver did not return a usable DNS response. Check its route, port, upstream configuration, TLS identity and clock.
message.interface_pass: The configured VPS VPN interface exists.
message.interface_fail: The VPS VPN interface is missing. Use server repair to restore it.
message.wireguard_pass: The server reports its configured WireGuard interface as active.
message.wireguard_fail: The running WireGuard identity, interface or port does not match the server configuration. Use server repair.
message.dns_pass: The configured private resolver services are active.
message.dns_fail: A private resolver service is inactive. Use server repair, then rerun diagnostics.
message.forwarding_fail: IPv4 forwarding is disabled. Use server repair to restore forwarding.
message.ipv6_pass: The server reports IPv6 forwarding and tunnel addressing as available.
message.ipv6_fail: IPv6 forwarding, addressing or NAT is unavailable. Use server repair.
message.server_process_pass: The SirinVPN system service is active.
message.server_process_fail: The SirinVPN system service is inactive. Check its installation or use server repair.
message.server_routes_pass: The main routing table has an external IPv4 or IPv6 default route and the configured tunnel subnet route.
message.server_routes_fail: The external default route or tunnel subnet route is missing. Check VPS networking and use server repair for the tunnel route.
message.server_firewall_pass: SirinVPN firewall hooks and tunnel isolation rules are present. Other firewall policies can still affect connectivity.
message.server_firewall_fail: SirinVPN firewall hooks or tunnel isolation rules are missing. Use server repair to restore its owned rules.
message.server_nat4_pass: A source masquerade rule exists for the configured tunnel subnet.
message.server_nat4_fail: The configured tunnel subnet has no source masquerade rule. Use server repair to restore IPv4 NAT.
message.server_nat6_pass: A source masquerade rule exists for the private IPv6 tunnel subnet.
message.server_nat6_fail: The private IPv6 subnet has no source masquerade rule. Use server repair to restore IPv6 NAT.
message.server_ports_pass: Configured VPN transport, private management and DNS listening sockets are present. This does not verify the provider firewall.
message.server_ports_fail: A configured transport, private management or DNS listener is missing. Check server services or use server repair.
message.server_mtu_pass: The VPS interface MTU meets the IP protocol minimum. Client probes determine the usable path MTU.
message.server_mtu_fail: The VPS tunnel interface MTU is below the IP protocol minimum. Use server repair.
message.external_reachability: Local listeners cannot establish public reachability. If a transport fails, check the VPS provider firewall and configured public ports.
message.dns_blocklist_pass: DNS blocking uses the latest refreshed list.
message.dns_blocklist_failed: The latest blocklist refresh failed, so DNS blocking keeps the last good list. Check the list addresses and the VPS internet access.
message.os_security_updates_on: Automatic security updates for the VPS operating system are on.
message.os_security_updates_off: Automatic security updates are off or could not be confirmed. Repair VPS with “Turn on automatic security updates” selected switches them on.
message.os_reboot_current: The VPS runs its newest installed kernel.
message.os_reboot_pending: An installed update may wait for a VPS restart. Restart the VPS when a short VPN interruption is acceptable.
message.diagnostics_busy: Another current-state check is running. Try again in a few seconds.
message.state_unreadable: This current state could not be read. Check server tools and service permissions, then rerun diagnostics.
message.resource_limited: Current usage: {{percent}}%. Capacity is limited. Free resources or increase the VPS capacity.
message.resource_unavailable: A current resource reading is unavailable.
message.dns_valid_time: Valid DNS response in {{millis}} ms. No query history is retained.
message.local_diagnostics_busy: A previous check is still finishing. Wait a moment or cancel any connection attempt, then try again.
message.local_diagnostics_unavailable: The checks couldn’t finish. Refresh the connection status and try again.
message.local_diagnostics_timeout: The checks didn’t finish within {{seconds}} seconds; another connection or server request may still be running. Wait a moment or cancel any connection attempt, then try again.

speedTest.title: Speed test to your VPS
speedTest.description: Measures download, upload and latency through the VPN to your own VPS over one connection, so it isn’t your internet speed. It takes about 20 seconds and briefly slows the VPN for everyone. The result stays on this device.
speedTest.running: Measuring the tunnel to your VPS…
speedTest.failed: The speed test didn’t finish. Check that this device is connected, then try again.

error.unsavedSettings: Save or discard your changes in Settings, then connect.
error.settingsNotLoaded: Connection settings aren’t loaded yet. Open Settings and try again.
error.connectionChange: The connection didn’t change. Refresh the status and try again.
error.stopUnconfirmed: The VPN didn’t confirm it stopped. Check its status.
error.resume: Couldn’t resume. Your traffic settings are unchanged.
error.diagnostics: Couldn’t run diagnostics. Refresh the status and try again.
